items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I wonder if you ever heard your father mention the name of Dark Age, George Park Hill. Oh, yes. Quite famous. Yes.

ctx.x: He's not even listed Tio. It would be listed as Long. It's under Long. Long. He lives with his sister-in-law, I think, or brother-in-law, or some relative. Oh, I see. And you would find it under Long.
I wonder if you ever heard your father mention the name of Dark Age, George Park Hill. Oh, yes. Quite famous. Yes.
And, uh, uh, Bechet, they have a fellow named Bechet. I knew him very well, Sidney.
